fields.summary_ko.0: Apple (AAPL) needs to rise 32% to reach a $460 price target for 2027, a level achieved 5 times over the past 10 years.
fields.summary_ko.1: Apple has beaten EPS estimates for 10 consecutive quarters and achieved fiscal 2026 revenue of $478.8B (+15.06%) and EPS of $8.98; fiscal 2027 EPS expected at $9.43 (+5%).
fields.summary_ko.2: iPhone Duo demand is exceeding supply, Services segment revenue reached a record $31.6B (76% margin), and Greater China revenue grew 21% in Q4.
